text: Been waiting ages for someone to get back to me. I'm a foster carer, the baby I have is 8 months. She's got a few insect bites on her arms that are itchy and she keeps rubbing them. Also a bruise on her shin but thats from the playground this afternoon, she slipped off the little step and I saw it happen so I know where it came from. No fits or shaking or anything. I think shes fine really but I need to know what I can put on the bites for an 8 month old, cream or antihistamine or what? Just need an answer please.
